subject.title: [Feature Request] Auto-linkify URLs in tool output cards (Control UI & WebChat)

question: Should this feature require native WebChat parity in the same change, or should the accepted scope be Control UI only?
rationale: Control UI and native WebChat use independent renderers; the issue explicitly names both, but the closed prior PRs only addressed portions of Control UI and do not establish an accepted product boundary.

options.title: Require both surfaces
options.body: Implement safe, behaviorally equivalent URL rendering in Control UI and native WebChat so the request has cross-client parity.

options.title: Narrow to Control UI
options.body: Accept a focused Control UI change now and record native WebChat parity as separate follow-up work.

recommendation.title: Require both surfaces
recommendation.body: Implement safe, behaviorally equivalent URL rendering in Control UI and native WebChat so the request has cross-client parity.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent detailed review on this issue already identified the cross-client scope decision and the affected render paths.
